title: "Descriptives and international case definitions"
output: html_document

Reproduces the parts of **Table 3** that come from the analytic datasets, **Table 4**
(international case definitions, patients aged 14 and over) and **Table S4** (children
under 14 in South Sudan).

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(here)
source(here("R", "data.R"))
source(here("R", "metrics.R"))

ssd <- load_ssd(binary = TRUE)
ssd_children <- load_ssd(children = TRUE, binary = TRUE)
bd <- load_bd(binary = TRUE)
```

## Table 3: patient characteristics

IgG, jaundice signs (yellow skin/eyes, dark urine, pale stools), hospitalisation and
death are not in the analytic datasets, so those rows cannot be reproduced here.

```{r table3}
n_pct <- function(x) sprintf("%d (%.0f)", sum(x), 100 * mean(x))
med_iqr <- function(x) sprintf("%.1f (%.1f, %.1f)", median(x), quantile(x, 0.25), quantile(x, 0.75))

describe <- function(dat, female, age, days, symptoms) {
  groups <- list(Overall = dat,
                 `IgM negative` = dat[dat$infect_bin == 0, ],
                 `IgM positive` = dat[dat$infect_bin == 1, ])
  rows <- function(d) c(
    N = nrow(d),
    Female = n_pct(female(d)),
    `Age, median (IQR)` = med_iqr(d[[age]]),
    `14-19` = n_pct(d[[age]] < 20),
    `20-39` = n_pct(d[[age]] >= 20 & d[[age]] < 40),
    `40-59` = n_pct(d[[age]] >= 40 & d[[age]] < 60),
    `60+` = n_pct(d[[age]] >= 60),
    `Days since jaundice onset, median (IQR)` = med_iqr(d[[days]]),
    sapply(symptoms, function(s) n_pct(d[[s]] == 1))
  )
  as.data.frame(sapply(groups, rows))
}

describe(ssd, function(d) d$id_sex == "Female", "age", "days_since_ajs_baseline", SSD_SYMPTOMS)
describe(bd, function(d) d$sex == "2", "age", "days_since_ajs", BD_SYMPTOMS)
```

## Table 4: international case definitions (aged 14 and over)

Acute jaundice alone is met by everyone (sensitivity 100%, specificity 0%).
CIs are Wilson score intervals.

```{r table4}
international_table(ssd, INTERNATIONAL_DEFS$ssd)
international_table(bd, INTERNATIONAL_DEFS$bd)
```

## Table S4: international case definitions (children under 14, South Sudan)

```{r tableS4}
international_table(ssd_children, INTERNATIONAL_DEFS$ssd)
```
